intro: Torn from the baffling Twilight Tome, these Insane Scribbles are a fragment of dark literature carried by cultists in Darkshore. Merely looking at the dancing text and distorted scrollwork induces severe dizziness and mental strain. Ancient protectors of the forest study such fragments to decipher the sinister motives of the Twilight's Hammer.

p: Gazing upon the pages of the Twilight Tome proves profoundly hazardous to mortal sanity. The script writhes across the parchment, while graceful scrollwork warps into grotesque, unsettling imagery before the reader's eyes. Tearing loose even a single sheet—these Insane Scribbles—is an ordeal that leaves the bearer lightheaded and disoriented. Despite the chaotic incoherence of the script, the parchment hums with a primal, deeply ancient magic tied directly to dark powers long buried beneath Azeroth.
